verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's features page says users can create and send customizable email campaigns with pro templates, which covers templated email sending from inside the product. The evidence is a single marketing-level line about campaigns, though, and nothing documents multi-step sequences. The workflow-automation pages describe triggered flows in general terms but never mention email cadences. Missing for 10: documented multi-step email sequences/cadences, evidence of one-to-one templated emails to prospects from deal/contact records, in-depth docs and hands-on corroboration.
